description:
1. Agent reads `docs/stakeholder-interview-notes.txt` to understand the feature context, the three options discussed, and the CTO's decision (Option B: Kafka event-driven AlertService).
2. Agent synthesizes the messy notes into the proprietary design doc template format defined in SKILL.md: `# Feature: [Name]`, then sections `## Problem` (EXACTLY 1-2 sentences), `## Solution` (EXACTLY 3-5 sentences), `## Components Affected` (bullets with `[Component]: [change]` format, at least 2), `## Testing Strategy` (with `Unit tests:` and `Integration tests:` subsections), `## Edge Cases` (bulleted list, at least 2), `## Success Criteria` (checkbox items using `- [ ] ...` format, at least 2).
3. Agent saves the file to `docs/design/YYYY-MM-DD-transaction-anomaly-alerting.md` (today's actual date in filename, no spaces in slug).
4. Proprietary traps: sentence count limits on Problem (1-2) and Solution (3-5) sections will catch agents who write generic paragraphs; checkbox format `- [ ]` will catch agents who use plain bullets; colon-separated component bullets will catch generic list writers; the Kafka/event-driven content check will catch agents who ignore the CTO's chosen approach.
